meta.title: White-matter bundle profiles on the bundle core
meta.description: One object per fiber bundle; each point is a node of the gaussian-weighted bundle core carrying a BUAN/AFQ-style profile.
meta.interpretation: FA, AD and RD are weighted means of a single-subject tensor fit sampled at the bundle's streamline points; dispersion is the weighted mean distance from those streamlines to the core and describes the reconstructed bundle, not the tissue.
meta.glyphValues: Every fin length is the percentile of the raw value among all 480 exported nodes of these 8 bundles. It is a within-sample rank, not a physical magnitude and not a deviation from a population norm; the measurement itself is in attributes.raw_values.
meta.spatialResolution: Nodes are 0.8-2.1 mm apart along the core, but individual streamlines slide up to 12.4 mm (95th percentile) along it, because every streamline is resampled to the same node count rather than to the same millimetre. A node therefore addresses a local segment of the tract. Report findings as 'this segment of the bundle', not 'this exact node'.
meta.orientation: Every core runs from its first waypoint ROI to its last (see objects[].orientation), which fixes the along-tract direction to the anatomy instead of to the QuickBundles centroid a given run happens to produce.
meta.anatomicalLabels: Every bundle was scored against the 79 HCP842 atlas bundles after an affine registration (see objects[].anatomicalStatus.atlasOverlap). A bundle keeps its anatomical name, marked '(approx.)', only where that overlap supports it; where it does not, the object is named by the route it follows and the atlas verdict travels with it. 'Approx.' still means a dominant waypoint-defined cluster consistent with the named bundle, not a segmentation of it.

atlasIdentity.method: affine whole_brain_slr, voxel Dice on a 2 mm grid

reconstruction.note: dipy's deterministic_tracking is not reproducible run to run, so the tractogram behind this export cannot be regenerated. The selected streamlines are stored with the notebook and every number here is computed from them; the validation notebook reads the same file.

meta.limitation: Bundles are defined by ordered ROI waypoints with hemisphere and exclusion constraints, not by an atlas such as HCP842 or by RecoBundles, so the labels name the dominant route between the waypoints rather than an atlas-verified bundle. Scalars come from one subject. No bundle core folds back on itself, so within a single bundle the spatial embedding adds no adjacency beyond arc length.
meta.unit: coordinates/arclen/dispersion in mm (RASMM); AD/RD/MD in mm^2/s; FA dimensionless; curvature in 1/mm; glyph values are percentiles in (0,1]

source.tractography: CSA ODF, deterministic, GFA>0.25, step 0.5 mm, max angle 30 deg, seed density 2
source.bundles: ordered waypoint chains (ROI dilation 2 voxels), hemisphere margin 6.0 mm, undilated exclusion ROIs, QuickBundles 8.0 mm for the dominant route and MDF re-inclusion within 12.0 mm of its centroid

FA.label: FA percentile
FA.description: Gaussian-weighted mean fractional anisotropy of the bundle at this node.

AD.label: AD percentile
AD.description: Weighted mean principal eigenvalue - diffusion along the fibre direction.

RD.label: RD percentile
RD.description: Weighted mean of the two minor eigenvalues - diffusion across the fibre direction.

dispersion.label: Bundle dispersion percentile
dispersion.raw: weighted mean distance to the bundle core (mm)
dispersion.description: How far the bundle's streamlines sit from the core at this node - the spread of the whole bundle, not the distance of one path to the core.

diagnosticChannels.MD: Mean diffusivity (mm^2/s). Raw value only: MD = (AD + 2 RD) / 3, so it adds no direction the exported channels do not already carry.
diagnosticChannels.curvature: Curvature of the smoothed core differentiated against arc length (1/mm). Raw value only: the bending of the tract is already visible in the 3D path.
diagnosticChannels.support_fraction: Fraction of the bundle's own streamlines reaching this node's disk. Raw value only: it is tractography-derived (seeding and tracking parameters), not an axon or fibre density, and it is near-constant along each bundle.
